feeds.title: Catholic Bible Talk
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Marc. I'm a meteorologist by trade, with personal interests in Catholic theology, Bible study, and the intersection between science and faith. My interest in studying the Bible in-depth was fanned into flame by the Catholic Bibles Blog. I hope to continue the legacy of that blog and foster a community of people who share an interest in all topics related to the Bible.

feeds.title: Come Into The Word with Sarah Christmyer Blog
feeds.description: Sarah Christmyer shares weekly reflections on the Bible in this weekly Scripture blog, where she invites you to 'come into the Word' and reflect. She is an author and speaker who believes in connecting Catholics to Christ through scripture. Find information on her Bible Studies, books, and speaking engagements.

feeds.title: Catholic Bible Press Blog
feeds.description: Catholic Bible Press specializes in creating beautiful Bibles and resources that serve a deeper understanding of God through the Sacred Scriptures of the Christian faith.

feeds.title: Catholic Bible Student
feeds.description: A Blog About the Bible, Catholicism and the Habit of Study. I love the Bible and want to help Catholics read it more and read it well. I enjoy reading, writing, and teaching. Blog by Mark Giszczak.

feeds.title: Defenders of the Catholic Faith » Biblical Exposition
feeds.description: The following section of Defenders of the Catholic Faith is dedicated to Biblical Exposition. Steve Ray is writing Bible study notes and has written a book, 'Crossing the Tiber' (Ignatius Press), which was originally intended as a letter to his father describing his reasons for becoming Catholic. The Rays have brought other families into the Church and intend to continue to do so.

feeds.title: Catholics & Bible Blog
feeds.description: Catholics & Bible is a Catholic answers blog & forum run by a married couple in Chicago answering questions about Bible, Christ, Catholic life & more. Finding a genuine faith is a lifelong pursuit.

feeds.title: Catholic Heart and Mind » Bible Study
feeds.description: The following section of Catholic Heart and Mind publishes articles and write-ups on Bible Study. I'm Lee, a Catholic convert & blogger, former Protestant, New Ager, Buddhist. I blog about Catholicism and the Church in general, whatever gets the attention of my Catholic heart and mind.

feeds.title: Catholic Productions Blog
feeds.description: We are a company located in the New Orleans area, offering quality services and products in the media and apparel industry, and the best Catholic Biblical study recordings available by some of the most informative, passionate, and faithful speakers in the world. The mission of Catholic Productions is pretty simple to re-fascinate the world with the message of Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: Bible Review Blog
feeds.description: The focus of the Bible Review Blog is to celebrate the Bible and inspire people to read it by exploring this vast landscape of modern biblical publication and calling attention to some of the finest and most unique Bibles out there.
